drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Counsel: Attached is our revised draft reflecting your proposed payment mechanics, closing timetable, financial-statement representation and indemnification framework, subject to client approval. The opening cash-price proposal remains subject to instructions, and the price placeholder remains unchanged. All terms remain subject to agreement on the complete transaction documents.

edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The Buyer shall pay the Seller USD [●] (the “Purchase Price”) for the Shares in full at Closing by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by the Seller in writing, without escrow, holdback or set-off.
edits.name: Purchase price and payment mechanics

edits.text: 2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur within thirty days after signing this Agreement. The Buyer’s obligation to complete the purchase is not subject to any financing condition.
edits.name: Closing timetable and financing

edits.text: 3. REPRESENTATIONS. The Seller represents that the financial statements fairly present, in all material respects, the financial position of the Company as of their respective dates and its results of operations and cash flows for the periods covered thereby.
edits.name: Financial-statement representation

edits.text: 4. INDEMNITY. The Seller shall indemnify the Buyer solely for losses arising from breaches of the Seller’s express representations in this Agreement. Those representations shall survive Closing for twelve months. Any indemnification claim must be notified to the Seller in writing, with reasonable particulars, before that period expires; a claim so notified shall survive until finally resolved. The Seller shall be liable only to the extent aggregate indemnifiable losses exceed one percent of the Purchase Price, and only for the excess. The Seller’s aggregate liability under this Section shall not exceed ten percent of the Purchase Price. The Buyer shall not recover more than once for the same loss.
edits.name: Limited indemnification
